gaps.title: Pressure and air temperature not yet validated against independent station observations
gaps.whyItMatters: The published pressure and air temperature come from the nearest stations; whether the station chosen represents the lake (distance, elevation, AWOS altimeter vs sea-level pressure) is unmeasured.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Whether the Barometric Pressure and Air Temperature tiles, and the change signal built on them, describe the water the bowfisher is on.
currentEvidence: Engine adapter recordings 2026-11-06 (3 lakes, one moment)
retrospective protocol WX-RETRO-2026-11-23.3 pre-registered 2026-11-23 (plan section 5.4; .2 and v1 superseded before any data); not yet run
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when the pre-registered comparison in docs/brains/WEATHER_BRAIN_PLAN.md section 5 is scored on its 30-day window.
gaps.expectedOutput: Scored comparison report with pass/fail per pre-registered criterion.

humanOrFieldValidationRequired.what: OPTIONAL: owner or field barometer/thermometer readings at the lake may be added; never required.

gaps.title: Weather-change thresholds v1 are pre-stated, not yet checked
gaps.whyItMatters: Too sensitive and Lake/Water Temp refresh for nothing; too strict and a front passes unnoticed.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Whether the water-level and water-temperature readings a bowfisher sees were refreshed when the weather turned.
currentEvidence: retrospective protocol WX-RETRO-2026-11-23.3 pre-registered 2026-11-23 (plan section 5.4; .2 and v1 superseded before any data); not yet run
gaps.stopCondition: Stop after 60 days of CHANGE events are compared with NWS surface-analysis front positions and observed rain (plan section 5.3).
gaps.expectedOutput: Hit rate and false-alarm rate per event kind; a thresholds-v2 proposal only if a pre-registered criterion fails.

gaps.title: No pressure forecast
gaps.whyItMatters: The NWS forecast grid has no pressure layer, so the app's 'Next 3 hours expected' pressure readout cannot come from this Brain.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Whether a falling barometer is about to bottom out before the trip.
currentEvidence: Engine adapter note (NWS_WEATHER_ADAPTER_V1 section 4): NDFD pressure layer empty
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when an official, documented pressure forecast source is identified and approved, or the owner accepts the gap.

gaps.title: Directory lakes outside NWS coverage
gaps.whyItMatters: /points returns 404 outside the US NWS grid; those lakes get readiness BLOCKED and no state.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Whether a bowfisher at such a lake sees any Weather state at all.
currentEvidence: not measured: needs the first full-directory dry run
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when the first full-directory dry run has counted BLOCKED lakes.
